systems.system: Opération spéciale « Un enfant, un acte de naissance »
systems.country_label: Un enfant, un acte de naissance
systems.platform: smartphones for community agents; civil-status forms distributed in schools
systems.owner: Government (Vice-Premier ministre chargé de l'Administration du territoire), with UNICEF
systems.tiers: first phase in twelve provinces, July to December 2026: household census of children by trained community agents, and forms filled in at schools from the next school year; target of at least one million children aged 4 months to 17 years, each to receive a secured birth certificate bearing a Numéro national d'identification unique (NNIU)

note: A six-month campaign, class outreach; the certificate it issues is to carry the national identification number, but no office system and no link between registers is described.
